profile head with a curved beak-like snout
bands of repeated short parallel strokes / ladder-like pattern

justification: Both are tall, vertically stacked compositions that include a beaked profile head, small discs, and repeated ladder-like or dotted decorative bands, and both include an anthropomorphic figure with visible arms and hands. But A is a coarse, low-relief carving organised into separate horizontal registers of animals with much blank ground, whereas B is a dense, single centralised costumed figure drawn in fine continuous outline with no register divisions, so the resemblance is limited to generic motif types rather than any shared scheme or hand.
